notes: SAIB quarterly Data Supplement (.xlsx, SAR million). Raw reported lines only; the workbook's own ratios (NPL, coverage, NIBD share, Tier 1, CAR, LCR, NSFR, financing-to-deposits, return on equity, NIM, cost-to-income, cost of risk) are not mapped - regulatory capital comes from the Pillar 3 KM1 reader and every other ratio is recomputed by the engine. Values are rounded to the issuer's reported precision (thousands of SAR = 3 decimals in SAR million; EPS to 2 decimals) because formula cells carry binary float noise. Cross-checked against the audited FY2025 manifest: net income, EPS, operating expenses, provisions, other income and term loans agree. 'Other reserves' is deliberately not mapped: it differs in definition from the audited statement's other reserves (FY2025 SAR 2,206.472 mn in the workbook vs SAR -361,424 thousand audited). 'Term loans' maps to debt_securities_issued, matching the audited statement's line. The workbook has no total-operating-expenses line (impairment is presented separately), so total_operating_expenses is not derived. The 2Q-2026 vintage states that certain balance sheet figures from 1Q 2024 onwards were restated (cash and balances with SAMA; due to banks).
